options.text: I'd like to claim my port task rewards.

steps.player: I'd like to claim my port task rewards.

steps.text: If the player has a completed port task:
If the player has no completed port tasks:

steps.npc: According to my records, you don't have any port task rewards to claim.

options.text: I'd like to cancel a port task.

steps.player: I'd like to cancel a port task.

steps.text: If the player has no active tasks:

talking-to-the-port-master-before-comple.npc: Hi there. How can I help you?

talking-to-the-port-master-before-comple.player: What do you do around here?

talking-to-the-port-master-before-comple.npc: I'm the port master. It's my job to keep everything around here running nice and smoothly for all the vessels coming and going.

options.text: So could you tell me how I could get my own vessel?
options.condition: If the player has not yet sailed with Will and Anne during the quest:

steps.player: So could you tell me how I could get my own vessel?

steps.npc: I'm afraid not, but maybe someone else around here could help. I saw a couple of people further north on the docks. I think I heard them saying they were looking for help on their boat.

options.text: Sounds like quite a challenging job. I'd best not distract you.

steps.player: Sounds like quite a challenging job. I'd best not distract you.

claim-rewards-or-cancel-task-before-comp.npc: I'm afraid I can't help you with that at the moment. You'll have to come back later.

claim-rewards-or-cancel-task-before-comp.text: You need to complete the Pandemonium quest to fully access the Sailing skill.

claim-rewards-or-cancel-task-before-sail.npc: I'm afraid I can't help you with that at the moment. You'll have to come back later.

claim-rewards-or-cancel-task-before-sail.text: The Sailing skill will release on the 19th November.
